title: Gains and losses in zinc-ion batteries by proton- and water-assisted reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4531-4566
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00810C, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yauhen Aniskevich, Seung-Taek Myung
This review systematically discusses water-related and proton-assisted equilibria and reactions in zinc-ion batteries. Water-related dissolution, deposition, and amorphization phenomena are covered.
